correctness.rationale: Both displayed matrices have rank \(2\). Exhaustive enumeration of their \(25\) messages gives the same stated Euclidean-weight enumerator. The exact formula \(A_2=2\sum_j\binom{\eta_j}{2}\) follows because Euclidean weight \(2\) can only be two symbols of weight \(1\), and the dual equation then forces the corresponding columns to agree up to sign; it gives \(14\) for \(C^\perp\) and \(10\) for \(D^\perp\). Independent syndrome dynamic programming confirms the full dual sizes \(5^7\) and these coefficients. Exhaustion of all normalized full-rank multiplicity vectors for effective lengths \(2\) through \(8\) proves the stated finite sharpness.
